name: IMG_LOAD_BALANCE_READ_SER
description: The table storing the data in the related multi-response ORD Item 52872. This data represents the reading providers responsible for an order at a given instant a load balancing action was performed on the order.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the order record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple values associated with a specific group of data within this record.

columns.name: LD_BALANCE_READ_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.
